messages.author: arjun.mehta
messages.text: Benchmark for recs-engine is up in ATL-14. FalkorDB vs Neo4j on 3-hop queries over the event graph.

messages.author: lena.novak
messages.text: Nice. FalkorDB numbers look about 4x better on p95. Let's take it to the Atlas architecture review.

messages.author: chloe.dubois
messages.text: Memory footprint is lower too. Cypher support covers everything we need.

messages.author: aiko.tanaka
messages.text: From the data-pipeline side, Kafka consumers can write to either. No blocker.

messages.author: lena.novak
messages.text: Heads up: search-api is now owned by the Growth team. Ranking work lives with recs, so it makes sense. Ping me or Chloe.

messages.author: marco.rossi
messages.text: Confirmed from Platform side, handover doc is in the tracker.

messages.author: nora.fischer
messages.text: Reorg update: payments-service is now owned by the Platform team. Marco Rossi is the escalation contact. Payments team focuses on Ledger compliance.

messages.author: priya.sharma
messages.text: Thanks Nora. I'll walk Marco's team through the idempotency internals this week.

messages.author: marco.rossi
messages.text: Welcome payments-service to Platform. Jonas will be primary on-call for it.

messages.author: hannah.kim
messages.text: Friday deploys are allowed again before 2pm, canary required. Guardrails are live in the deploy-pipeline.

messages.author: carlos.mendes
messages.text: Great, that unblocks the payments-service hotfix train.

messages.author: hannah.kim
messages.text: INC-7: card payments failing at checkout. Rolling back the 1:40pm checkout-web deploy.

messages.author: fatima.zahra
messages.text: Root cause: checkout-web sent a new payload shape that payments-service rejected. Canary only covered the browse flow.

messages.author: olu.adeyemi
messages.text: Resolved after 3 hours. Postmortem Monday. I'm going to propose bringing back the Friday deploy freeze.

messages.author: sam.okafor
messages.text: As you know my last day is July 31. I'm writing up the auth-gateway token rotation steps but the SAML refresh is still manual.

messages.author: mei.lin
messages.text: I can shadow the next token rotation. I haven't touched the SAML metadata job yet.

messages.author: marco.rossi
messages.text: Thanks Sam. Mei, let's pair on auth-gateway next week.

messages.author: ben.carter
messages.text: Consumer lag on the recs topic is climbing again, 7 minutes.

messages.author: aiko.tanaka
messages.text: It's the partition skew from the user-id key. I'll rebalance the topic partitions on the data-pipeline; we need 12 instead of 6.

messages.author: aiko.tanaka
messages.text: Rebalanced. Kafka consumer lag back under 30s.

messages.author: sara.lindqvist
messages.text: gRPC-web is adding 40% to the mobile-app bundle. Older Android builds crash on the streaming calls.

messages.author: diego.alvarez
messages.text: Let's put a rollback to REST for mobile on the retro agenda.
